title: Samuel Leads Israel's Repentance and Victory at Mizpah
description: Samuel calls Israel to turn away from foreign gods and gathers the people at Mizpah, where they fast and confess their sins. When the Philistines attack, Samuel sacrifices a nursing lamb and cries out to the Lord, who responds with powerful thunder that causes confusion among the Philistines. Israel pursues and defeats them all the way to Beth-car. Samuel sets up a stone he calls Eben-ezer ("Thus far has the Lord helped us"), and the Philistines are humbled as long as Samuel lives.
